newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - DEC 30.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - DEC 30.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- National police chief Laszlo Forgach has drawn up plans for a leaner, more effective police force.
- Minister of Interior Gabor Kuncze said he only expects a police rewamp to bear fruit in the long term.
- The Pension Fund denied press reports that payments could be in danger due to lack of funds.
- Both the Finance Ministry and Polgari Bank officials had declined to comment press reports that the state has bought back the bank, a unit of Budapest Bank which is controlled by GE Capital.
- Trotting jockey Csaba Lakatos, shot in November in a Budapest gang war, will race again tomorrow.
